Name: Seasonal Clover Dig Spot
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[color=#fff2cc][b]Makes the artifact dig spots look like cute clover grass sprout.

[/b][/color]Additionally you can Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21638]Seasonal Clover Dig Spot (TV Patch) [/url]made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/277621]Theoddon[/url]  if you want the TV  to mention clovers instead of worms.

[b][size=3][color=#ffe599]Different colors for each season and locations:[/color]
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]spring
[*]summer
[*]fall
[*]winter
[*]desert
[*]ginger island
[/list]
[b][color=#ffe599][size=3]Config:[/size][/color][/b]
Change regular digspot in sandy locations - will change regular digspot to yellow color in Beach, Ginger Island and Desert maps (may cause lag when entering Beach - if you don't like it, turn off this option)
Change seeds digspot in sandy locations  will change seed digspot into starfish texture in Beach and Ginger Island maps (may cause lag when entering Beach - if you don't like it, turn off this option)

[color=#ffe599][size=3][b]Credits[/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*]Big thanks to Alexilyn for making their [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7786]Cute Grass Dig Spot[/url] that inspired me!
[*]Used Clover texture from HenrySoftware's [url=http://henrysoftware.itch.io/godot-pixel-items]Godot Pixel Asset Pack﻿[/url].﻿
[*]Used Starfish texture from Shubibubi's[url=https://shubibubi.itch.io/cozy-fishing] Fishing Asset Pack[/url]﻿.
